purpose: C++/sklearn equivalence, not a generalization measurement
sample_accuracy_caveat: Sample spans the full capture and overlaps the training split; not a held-out score. See model/metrics.json for that.
min_iat_note: min_iat shows large relative error: device timestamps are uint32 microseconds (1 us floor) while Python uses float seconds. Absolute error is <=1 us and no prediction changed, but sub-microsecond intervals are not representable on device.
